A '''magfield sensor ball''' was an outdated [[Sensor/Legends|sensory]] input device utilized with [[Mark II reactor drone/Legends|Mark II reactor drone]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and other simple [[Labor droid/Legends|labor droids]]. The sensor ball was a simple metal ball contained in a wire cage that allowed a droid to "perceive" its surroundings any time the ball hit the cage. This situation was usually encountered when the droid ran into an obstacle or had begun to tip over.
